quarterly_data.signal: Head of research Mike Quigley added clinical detail behind the Q2 pipeline decisions: the ESTUARY phase III study of amlitelimab in atopic dermatitis showed sustained maintenance of clinical response without relapse for up to 72 weeks, with no new cases of Kaposi's sarcoma, before Sanofi decided not to progress to global regulatory submission; balinatunfib programs were discontinued after phase II studies in Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis did not meet internal efficacy expectations; and the final phase III readout for Sarclisa in transplant-eligible multiple myeloma expected for the remainder of 2026 'will result in another U.S. label expansion'. CEO Belen Garijo said the pipeline review is ongoing - 'I'm not excluding that we discontinue some additional assets' - with no target number of discontinuations.
quarterly_data.figure: amlitelimab ESTUARY response maintained for up to 72 weeks
